description:
Alpha Bank London Limited is seeking a Graduate KYC Analyst to join the Bank’s KYC Operations team. With guidance and training, you will support Customer Due Diligence (CDD), periodic reviews and screening activities for both individual and corporate client relationships.

This 3-month Fixed-Term Contract (FTC) offers an opportunity for recent graduates or early-career candidates to develop in KYC, AML, and Financial Crime Operations within a supportive banking environment.

Qualifications
• Recent degree or equivalent qualification; applications are welcomed from candidates without previous KYC experience.
• Interest in KYC, AML, financial crime prevention, banking or financial services, with a willingness to learn.
• Basic awareness of AML, CDD, sanctions, PEP or adverse media screening would be helpful, but full training will be provided.
• Confidence learning new systems and following defined procedures accurately.
• Good analytical, research and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and Excel.
• A proactive and organised approach, with the ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines and ask for support when needed.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Greek language skills would be advantageous but are not essential.

Responsibilities
• Support periodic KYC and CDD reviews for individual and corporate clients, under the guidance of experienced team members.
• Review client documents and information for completeness and accuracy, escalating gaps or inconsistencies where required.
• Carry out sanctions, PEP, adverse media and financial crime screening checks using the Bank’s systems and procedures.
• Assist with assessing client risk profiles and identifying potential AML, sanctions and financial crime concerns for escalation.
• Maintain accurate client records and help complete review activities within agreed timescales.
• Work collaboratively with Relationship Managers, Compliance and other colleagues to obtain information and resolve queries.
• Support basic management information reporting, record keeping and data quality checks.
• Contribute ideas to improve team processes and operational efficiency as knowledge and experience develop.
• Support wider Bank projects and team activities as required, while prioritising core KYC responsibilities.
title: Graduate KYC Analyst

description:
What's Your Possible?

Take on a role where your ideas, expertise and ambition can make a real difference, helping shape a secure and evolving energy future.

As a Risk Graduate, you'll help provide the analysis, reporting and controls that enable SEFE to make informed commercial decisions in a complex and fast-moving market environment. You'll work with experienced colleagues across Risk, Trading, Compliance and Middle Office functions to understand how risk is identified, measured, monitored and managed across the business.

This is an excellent opportunity for graduates who enjoy analytical thinking, problem-solving and understanding how businesses balance commercial opportunity with effective risk management. You'll gain broad business exposure while developing specialist knowledge across multiple risk disciplines.

What Will You Do?

•
Produce quantitative risk reporting and analysis used by stakeholders across Risk Management and Front Office teams to support commercial decision-making.

•
Analyse data, market information and business activities to identify key risks, trends and areas requiring further investigation.

•
Develop an understanding of market, credit and operational risk frameworks and how they are applied within a global energy trading business.

•
Create and maintain documentation including risk policies, methodologies, procedures and incident reporting materials.

•
Present findings, insights and recommendations to stakeholders across Risk and other business functions.

•
Contribute to projects that enhance risk management processes, controls and reporting capabilities.

•
Build strong relationships with colleagues across Risk, Trading, Compliance, Audit and other business areas, developing a broad understanding of SEFE's operations.

•
Take ownership of your professional development, building both technical expertise and commercial understanding throughout the programme.

What Will You Bring?

We're looking for curious and analytical graduates who enjoy working with data, solving problems and understanding how businesses manage risk in complex commercial environments.

You'll ideally have:

•
A Bachelor's or Master's degree (completed or due to be completed before the programme starts) in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Business, Data Science or another numerate discipline.

•
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate information, identify key issues and draw logical, well-reasoned conclusions.

•
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines and adapt to changing business needs and circumstances.

•
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to explain findings and recommendations clearly to a range of audiences.

•
The ability to build strong working relationships and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different teams and functions.

•
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with an interest in developing further analytical and technical skills.

•
Resilience, adaptability and a commitment to continuous learning and professional development in a dynamic business environment.

•
An interest in financial markets, energy trading, risk management or corporate governance. Previous internships, placements or work experience in financial services, energy, consulting or another analytical environment would be advantageous but are not essential.

Applications are open until 16 December 2026. After the application deadline, no further submissions will be accepted.

About Us

SEFE is an international energy company anchored in Europe, delivering energy solutions that ensure reliable and affordable supply. Our activities span the entire energy value chain – from origination and trading to sales, transport and storage. With decades of trading expertise and a growing LNG portfolio, SEFE is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to industrial customers, providing more than 200 TWh of gas and power each year. We supply over 50,000 clients, from small businesses to municipalities and multinational organisations. By investing in clean energies, we support our customers on their decarbonisation journey and contribute to the energy transition. SEFE employs over 2,000 people worldwide and is owned by the Federal Government of Germany.

Securing energy – now and for the future.

Our Mission at Janus Henderson is to help clients define and achieve superior financial outcomes through differentiated insights, disciplined investments, and world-class service. Clients Come First - Always | Execution Supersedes Intention | Together We Win | Diversity Improves Results | Truth Builds Trust

Your opportunity

This is a 12-month graduate programme from September 2027 focusing on gaining first-hand experience and discovering what your future would be like with us through induction, on the job learning, skills training and networking. Successful graduate will be considered for full-time positions at the end of the programme.

As the Investment Compliance Graduate, you will support and carry out critical Investment Compliance functions, including pre- and post-trade monitoring against regulatory requirements, operating policies, and fund/client investment restrictions, with a focus on equities, fixed income, and derivatives. description:
Finance Graduate Programme: Commercial Finance & FP&A

London | Competitive starting salary + progression | Fully funded CIMA | Starting January 2027.
The Super Bowl. Wimbledon. The Premier League. Eurovision. The Olympic Games.

Behind the moments the world watches, there's a team making them happen. Behind that team, there's a finance function keeping it all moving.

NEP is the global partner behind some of the biggest live events on the planet. We work in 25 countries, have more than 5,000 people, and have supported productions in over 100 countries across all seven continents. As we celebrate 40 years of bringing content to life, we're launching a programme to find the finance leaders of the future.
Is that you?

What you'll do

Over 3 years, you'll complete two 18-month rotations, one in Group Commercial Finance & FP&A and one in NEP Europe Finance. This is real work from day one, not shadowing. You'll:

•
See how a global business performs: help prepare month-end reporting across regions for Group leadership

•
Find the story behind the numbers: analyse results against budget and forecast, and explain what's driving them

•
Help shape what comes next: support budgeting, forecasting and revenue models

•
Track risks and opportunities: maintain the Group view of what could help or hurt performance

•
Work as a business partner: build relationships with finance teams and stakeholders across our international businesses

•
Make things better: suggest ways to improve our reporting, processes and tools

What you'll get

•
A fully funded CIMA qualification, covering tuition, materials, registration, subscriptions and exam fees

•
2 days' paid study leave for every exam, on top of your annual leave

•
International experience across Group and European finance teams

•
A structured development plan, with quarterly check-ins and reviews at the end of each rotation

•
Access to senior leaders, with regular exposure to an experienced senior management team

•
A permanent role from day one, with a clear path into a qualified finance role when you finish the programme

•
Competitive starting salary, with progression as you develop

Who we're looking for

You don't need to know everything about finance yet. You do need to be curious about how businesses make money and want to find out more. We're looking for people who are:

•
Good with numbers and analytical, and like solving problems

•
Strong communicators, confident to ask questions and share ideas

•
Adaptable and resilient, comfortable in a fast-paced, changing environment

•
Team players who are happy to roll up their sleeves when it counts

•
Ambitious, with the drive to grow into a future finance manager or leader

Why NEP?

Our values are Reliable, Ethical, Innovative and One Team. They shape how we work with each other and with our clients. When something needs to happen, everyone pitches in.
Ready to start your finance career where the world's biggest moments happen?

Applications close on 15 November 2026, although we reserve the right to close the advert early if we receive sufficient applications. Face-to-face interviews will be held in NEP's London office w/c 16 + 23 November 2026. Preferred start date is 12 January 2027, although we’re happy to be flexible for the right candidate.
NEP is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are happy to make adjustments throughout the recruitment process. This advert is not an exhaustive of the role and opportunity and is subject to change at the needs of the business.

description:
Overview

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.

Our 2027 Trading Operations Analyst Programme (OA) is a 6‑month rotational programme for soon‑to‑be and recent graduates. This programme provides a blend of education, skill building, and exposure to Susquehanna and the financial services industry. It will prepare you for a full‑time position that immediately impacts Susquehanna’s business. Through 4‑week rotations you will have the opportunity to gain exposure to every desk within Trading Operations such as Trade Support, Risk Operations, Stock Loan and Settlements. Once the programme is complete, you will be placed on a fast‑paced desk that directly impacts Susquehanna's performance.

This role is based in the UK; however, the first three months of the programme (September to December 2027) will take place in our Dublin office as part of an immersive graduate training experience. During this time, you will join peers from across Europe for in‑depth learning and hands‑on development before returning to the UK to complete the programme. You will have the necessary support to make this transition smooth and focused on your learning and development.
Our Programme:

As a Trading Operations Analyst you will be exposed to the full life cycle of Susquehanna’s trading activity and develop a fundamental understanding of the industry and trading environment which Susquehanna operates in. Trading Operations work at the intersection of trading, technology, and external counterparties, where you are empowered to develop strong relationships and work on exciting, valuable projects which have real impact and contribute to our success. Working alongside our team you will develop an in‑depth exposure to all the different trading desks and business areas at Susquehanna with each rotation incorporating hands‑on experience and real‑time projects to add value.

If you have a keen interest in the financial markets, collaborating with traders while up‑skilling technically then Trading Operations could be the role for you.
What we're looking for
• Problem Solver: You enjoy solving puzzles and love when you discover a solution to difficult problems. You’re not afraid to discuss ideas and work with others to find the optimal solution.
• Communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with. You enjoy sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts and listening to the views of others.
• Ambitious: You constantly set yourself goals in life and give your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics or another passion you have, you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential.
• Numerical & Logical: When it comes to decision making, you use clear and sound reasoning. You’re rational and like to use numbers and data to come up with sensible solutions.
• Curious: You’re eager to find out more about what it’s like to work in the Finance sector, and specifically Trading Operations. Have a passion and identifiable interest in the financial markets and current affairs.
• Soon‑to‑be or recent graduate: Our programme starts in early September 2027.
What's in it for you:
• Education: Susquehanna’s in‑house education programme is widely recognised as being the best in the industry. You will attend regular seminars to learn about in‑house business, products, and tech (Excel, SQL, Python etc.).
• Support: You will be assigned a mentor from our trading operations team for each of your rotations. You will also be assigned a buddy who was a previous OA to guide you along the way.
• Real Impact: You will work collaboratively with the technology team and traders on your desk to develop trade ideas and provide real‑time opinions throughout the trading day. You will collaborate on daily tasks and improvements which are key to the ongoing success of the business.
• Culture: Our culture allows employees of every level to thrive. We are not your typical trading firm – the environment is casual, collaborative and we focus on continuous development, no matter how long you’ve been in Susquehanna.
Interview Process:

Apply > Recruiter Interview > Interview > Final Interview > Offer

If you would like to read what our Trading Operations Analysts say about working in Susquehanna, check out the Meet Our Team page on our website: https://sig.com/about/team/
Final tip - We hire for this programme on a rolling basis, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early.

Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please contact us.

We're looking for talented individuals who bring initiative, creativity, and curiosity to the table. In return, you'll gain valuable hands-on experience, receive mentorship from some of the industry's best and earn recognised professional qualification.

By the end of your Graduate Programme, you’ll be a well-rounded, commercially minded professional, ready to take on interesting and challenging responsibilities. You won’t just be fully qualified - you’ll be fully prepared to drive your own career forward. 

What Sets Us Apart 

At MHA, people come first, our colleagues, our clients, and the communities we support. In 2026, we ranked as number 11 in the UK’s top accountancy firms and a proud member of Baker Tilly International, the world’s 8th largest network, we combine global insight with a strong local commitment. 

Our people‑centred approach is what truly makes us different. You will be welcomed as a valued member of a collaborative, purpose‑led team. We are committed to continuous learning, growth, and creating an environment where everyone can thrive and be themselves.

We are proud to hold the Investors in People Gold award, recognising our commitment to supporting, developing, and valuing every individual. 

Here, You’ll Go Beyond Numbers 

We are looking for a Tax Associate to join us who is comfortable in an evolving environment and enjoys solving a variety of challenges that contribute to meaningful outcomes. 

At MHA, you will be surrounded by passionate professionals who are committed to making a difference. Your work in Tax will go beyond the numbers, we believe in hands-on learning. You’ll be doing real work on real projects, not just shadowing. While you’ll receive mentorship and guidance, we prefer you to learn through extensive and practical on-the-job training.

What does a career in indirect Tax actually involve?

Indirect Tax is focused on helping businesses manage taxes that arise from their everyday transactions, particularly VAT and customs duties. Working with a wide range of clients, you'll help businesses stay compliant, manage risk and navigate increasingly complex UK and international tax rules. From an early stage, you'll support work such as VAT registrations, preparing or reviewing VAT returns, researching technical legislation, and assisting businesses during HMRC enquiries. As your knowledge develops, you'll gain exposure to more complex areas including cross-border transactions, import and export taxes, customs procedures, and international VAT compliance. It's a career that combines technical problem solving with commercial awareness and client interaction. If you're interested in how businesses operate and enjoy solving practical challenges, Indirect Tax could be a great fit for you.

As an Indirect Tax Associate, you'll experience the power of collaboration as you work with diverse teams and a varied client portfolio. Start by learning the fundamentals, including:
• Supporting businesses with VAT registrations and ongoing VAT compliance obligations
• Assisting with the preparation and review of VAT returns to help clients meet filing requirements accurately and on time
• Helping clients understand the VAT implications of trading goods and services across the UK and internationally
• Supporting clients during HMRC VAT inspections, enquiries and compliance checks
• Assisting with import, export and customs-related tax matters, helping businesses navigate international trade requirements
• Studying towards your Professional Qualifi

description:
Company: Top Commercial Finance Brokerage Firm

Role: Graduate Finance Broker Programme

Location: London, EC4M (5 days in office)

Commission: High uncapped commission following programme completion

Start Date: March 2027

Overview

A standout opportunity to launch a high-performance sales career in commercial finance. Our client is growing rapidly and is looking for ambitious, competitive graduates to join at an exciting stage of its growth. You will build relationships, win new business, and develop into a successful Commercial Finance Broker.

(This is a sales-focused position - if you are seeking a traditional analyst role, this opportunity will not be the right fit.)

Why should you apply?

As part of the Graduate Finance Broker pathway, you will receive:

• The opportunity to join a newly launched London office and grow with the team

• Dedicated 1-2-1 mentorship and coaching from Sales Directors and senior brokers

• A structured 24-month development programme, rotating through four six-month placements to build broad commercial, sales and client experience

• Hands-on exposure to prospecting, client conversations, credit proposals, lender submissions and live transactions

• A clearly defined route to becoming a qualified Commercial Finance Broker

Earnings potential is significant, with uncapped commission once you move into a fee-earning role:

• £70,000-£85,000 in your first fee-earning year after completing the programme

The culture is merit-based and performance-led, with progression tied to what you deliver. As you develop, additional benefits can include gym membership, car allowance and private medical insurance.

How the 24-month programme develops you

• Months 0-6: build the foundations - learn the core finance products, lender landscape and customer profiles while developing confidence in outbound prospecting and opportunity generation.

• Months 6-12: move closer to the full sales cycle - work alongside an experienced broker, develop client-handling skills and learn how to prepare credit proposals and supporting documentation.

• Months 12-18: take greater ownership - begin managing smaller transactions from initial conversation through to completion, while gaining exposure to larger and more complex deals.

• Months 18-24: refine your commercial and sales approach - broaden your exposure to senior leadership and prepare to qualify into a commission-generating broker role.

About the company

• Founded in 2007, the business supports UK SMEs by providing access to a wide range of funding solutions in one place.

• To date, it has arranged over £1 billion in finance for more than 15,000 businesses.

• The firm works with an extensive panel of over 40 lending partners alongside its own lending capability, helping businesses secure flexible finance solutions that protect cash flow and reduce upfront costs.

• It supports private-sector organisations across a broad range of industries, assisting with asset finance, equipment purchase, equity release and general business funding

What is the role?

As a Graduate Finance Broker, you will:

• Conduct outbound sales activity to generate interest, identify opportunities and build new client relationships

• Use a consultative sales approach to understand a client's business, funding needs and commercial priorities

• Develop knowledge across a broad range of commercial finance products and lenders

• Prepare proposals and credit applications, working with clients to gather relevant documentation

• Work alongside senior brokers and Sales Directors on live opportunities and transactions

• Accurately record activity within the CRM system

• Build and manage a live pipeline of opportunities

• Take on increasing ownership and responsibility as you progress through the programme

Who is best suited to this role?

• Success-driven people who genuinely enjoy competing, improving and winning - If coming third is good enough for you, please do not apply

• Highly motivated, target-driven individuals with a natural flair for sales

• Confident communicators who can build rapport and trust quickly

• Resilient people who are comfortable in a fast-paced, merit-based environment

• Commercially curious graduates with a genuine interest in business and how companies grow

• Entrepreneurial self-starters who want responsibility rather than a heavily managed graduate role

• Ideally ABB/AAB at A-Level and a 2:1 degree (or above) in any discipline - please provide your grades on your application

• A competitive sports background is advantageous, but not essential

We'd advise NOT applying if:

• You are looking for an analytical, research-led or back-office graduate position

• You are not comfortable with outbound calling, sales targets or a performance-based environment

• You do not want to work onsite in London 5 days a week

• You prefer a role with limited exposure to senior stakeholders and clients

• You are not motivated by relationship-building, commercial results, and uncapped earning potential

NB: Unfortunately, the employer is not sponsoring visas at this time.
title: Graduate Finance Broker Programme  - March 2027
